# Sankey v2 -- the flow template sensors.
#
# GENERATED by sankey_tests/gen_flow_yaml_v2.py. Do not hand-edit: the Jinja
# preamble is repeated verbatim eighteen times and test_jinja_parity.py asserts
# all eighteen copies are byte-identical.
#
# The generator used to live in a session scratchpad and was lost when that was
# cleaned up, which left this file un-regenerable and had to be rebuilt from it
# on 2026-09-11. It lives next to the tests now, in git, for that reason.
#
# This file is the SOURCE OF TRUTH for the Jinja. It is consumed by
#   - sankey_tests/test_jinja_parity.py    (renders it, compares to flows.py)
#   - the helper-creation script (feeds it to the template config flow)
# It is NOT a /config/configuration.yaml fragment -- there is no write path to
# /config from the dev machine, so the sensors are created as config-entry
# helpers instead. The YAML shape is kept anyway because it is the readable form.
#
# ----------------------------------------------------------- the three stages
# Each of the eighteen flows is a chain of THREE helpers:
#
#   flow_<s>_to_<t>_power    template, W      MAY go unavailable
#   flow_<s>_to_<t>_energy   integration, kWh (Riemann, left, max_sub 60 s)
#   flow_<s>_to_<t>_daily    utility_meter, daily cycle   <- the card's link value
#
# A FOURTH never-unavailable wrapper stage was built, measured, and CANCELLED
# on 2026-08-30. It is worth recording why, because the reasoning is not
# obvious and someone will propose it again.
#
# Unavailability really does propagate the whole length of the chain. Measured
# live by flipping one power template's availability to false:
#     before   template=369.6494    integration=0.063        meter=0.062
#     t+10s    template=unavailable integration=unavailable  meter=unavailable
#     t+130s   template=unavailable integration=unavailable  meter=unavailable
#     restored template=397.4359    integration=0.063        meter=0.062
# Nothing was invented or lost across the gap, but the meter does NOT hold.
#
# That looked fatal, because an unavailable link `value:` parses to NaN and
# Math.min NaN-poisons the source's spent total, silently zeroing every LATER
# ribbon from that source. It is not fatal, because the card never reads the
# live state on this path: with energy_date_selection: true the link `value:`
# goes through the SAME Recorder statistics substitution as a node's state
# (bundle chars 100603 -> 96800 -> 96959/97572/70176), so the value is
# sum(change), not hass.states. The substitution only needs the entity to
# EXIST in hass.states, and it does -- measured, the meter stays present and
# merely reads 'unavailable':
#     before/during/t+75s/restored : present=True, state 0.032 / unavailable /
#                                    unavailable / 0.033
#
# So the wrapper would have bought nothing while costing a `this.state`
# self-reference, eighteen more first-statistics-rows carrying change = 0, and a
# midnight stale-hold hazard. What the value: target MUST have is a
# state_class, because an entity with no statistics rows returns null from
# `ki`, which stringifies to "null" and parses to NaN. A utility_meter carries
# total_increasing natively, which is exactly why pointing at it directly is
# the safe option. Verified: all 36 flow ids appear in
# recorder/list_statistic_ids, and the meters compile rows. That count was
# taken when there were twelve flows; the air con adds three more chains and
# the same check should read 54 with Fridge (unverified live).
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------- conventions
# Sign conventions are Home Assistant's, NOT the raw Modbus registers':
#   sensor.solis_inverter_solar_power     W, DC, >= 0
#   sensor.solis_inverter_battery_power   W, DC, POSITIVE = CHARGING
#   sensor.solis_inverter_grid_power      W, AC, POSITIVE = IMPORTING
#   sensor.solis_inverter_house_load      W, AC, includes Tesla and fridge, excludes EPS
#   sensor.solis_inverter_backup_load     W, AC, separate EPS output (33148), ~10 s
#   sensor.tesla_home_charging_power      W, AC, >= 0
#   sensor.fridge_power                   W, AC, >= 0, direct ZHA measurement
#
# Entity names use v2-layout's vocabulary, which names a sink after its NODE:
# `grid` as a sink is EXPORT, `battery` as a sink is CHARGE. So flows.py's
# `solar_to_export` is the entity `flow_solar_to_grid_*`. The mapping lives in
# the generator and in test_jinja_parity.SLUG, and is asserted by a test.
#
# ------------------------------------------------------------------ the model
# BRIEF_V2.md section 2, proportional attribution with solar-only export:
#
#   S  = max(0, solar)              B = max(0, -battery)   C = max(0, battery)
#   G  = max(0, grid)               E = max(0, -grid)
#   T  = min(max(0, tesla), H)
#   F  = min(max(0, fridge), H - T)
#   A  = max(0, eps)
#   Hr = H - T - F
#   L  = max(0, (S + B + G) - (Hr + T + A + F + C + E))      <- the Inverter node
#
# House contains Tesla and fridge only; EPS is additional AC load (H + A).
# Keep *_to_aircon keys and helper ids for statistics continuity.
#
#   step 1  export is structurally solar-only:  s2e = min(S, E);  S1 = S - s2e
#   step 2  every remaining sink draws the same source mix:
#             w = S1/tot, b = B/tot, g = G/tot   with tot = S1 + B + G
#           and 0 for all three when tot == 0 (the zero-supply guard, exactly
#           `tot > 0`, no epsilon -- flows.py uses `total <= 0.0` and v1's
#           epsilon trim is not being repeated).
#
# There is no battery -> export link and never will be: all three discharge
# windows are unset. There is no battery -> battery link either; the battery
# cannot charge and discharge in the same sample, so B > 0 implies C == 0.
#
# ------------------------------------------------------------- unavailability
# Updated 2026-10-17: six guarded inputs, including EPS, require real numbers
# within +/-100 kW and use float without a default. EPS and House are read in
# the same Modbus block. Only fridge uses float(0): a missing reading leaves
# it inside House. The strict Python reference rejects bad fridge readings;
# live Jinja fallback/clamping is tested separately.
#
# Owner identifies EPS as air con plus a small charger. Its measured draw is
# outside House; no House cap or hourly-derived input applies to Air con.
# Values are rounded to 4 dp W, worst-case error 5e-5 W.
